## Description

A heavy gunner in olive-bronze power armor.

## Assets

Metadata for every file is in `character.yaml`.

- `smoke-keyart.webp`: master art
- `smoke-portrait.webp`: 1:1 portrait
- `smoke-token`: animated token (ammo belt ring) as `.webm` (use in Foundry, it shows animated WebP as a still frame), `.webp`, and `.gif` (under 8 MB, for Discord); `smoke-token.png` is the static version
